title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - GetOperationDataOutput
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/GetOperationDataOutput. This class specifies that the output of a get operation is going to be a datatype. Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own GetOperationOutput.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'GetOperationDataOutput'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasOutputDataType.description: Property. It identifies the datatype of the output. The value of this property conforms to the range of a datatype property of SAREF4GRID.
